name: plcsim_list_instances
description: List all registered Siemens S7-PLCSIM Advanced instances with ID, name, operating state, CPU type, and IP. S7-PLCSIM Advanced V8.0+ only (S7-1500 / ET 200SP virtual controllers); standard S7-PLCSIM (V18-V21), and therefore S7-1200 simulation, has no public API and is not supported. Returns an object {runtimeAvailable, apiPath, apiVersion, runtimeManagerAvailable, runtimeVersion, instances[], standardPlcSimProcesses[], message, error}; message explains an empty list, and standardPlcSimProcesses reports a running standard S7-PLCSIM. isError is set when the PLCSIM Advanced runtime is not available.
